summary:
FieldShift AI: Adapting Farms with NASA Data

FieldShift AI is an AI-powered agricultural platform designed to help farmers adapt to climate change and make smarter farming decisions using NASA Earth observation data.

The platform transforms satellite-based environmental information, including temperature, rainfall, and climate patterns, into practical agricultural insights. It helps farmers understand changing environmental conditions, assess potential risks, optimize irrigation, and make informed decisions about crop management.

By combining NASA data, artificial intelligence, interactive maps, and location-based agricultural analysis, FieldShift AI aims to make complex environmental information accessible and useful to farmers worldwide.

Our solution addresses the challenge of agricultural adaptation to climate change, water scarcity, and unpredictable weather conditions. It is important because agriculture depends heavily on environmental stability, while farmers increasingly need reliable information to protect crops, conserve water, and maintain productivity.

Our vision is to turn Earth observation data into smarter decisions for a more resilient and sustainable agricultural future.
details:
FieldShift AI is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers adapt to climate change, water scarcity, and unpredictable weather conditions.

The platform allows users to select or locate farms anywhere in the world using an interactive map and location search. Based on the selected location, crop information, and environmental conditions, FieldShift AI provides agricultural insights, irrigation guidance, and AI-powered recommendations. Our goal is to make complex environmental information easier to understand and turn it into practical decisions that farmers can use.

The project offers several benefits: helping farmers use water more efficiently, understand climate-related risks, improve crop management decisions, and prepare for changing environmental conditions. Its intended impact is to support more resilient and sustainable agriculture while making Earth observation data more accessible to farming communities worldwide.

We developed the mobile application using Flutter and Dart. The backend is built with Node.js and Express.js, while Google Gemini AI powers the agricultural assistant. We also used OpenStreetMap for interactive farm mapping, HTTP communication for API integration, and local storage to save farm locations and user preferences. Git and GitHub support version control and project collaboration.

What makes FieldShift AI creative is its combination of interactive mapping, location-based agricultural analysis, AI recommendations, and accessible mobile design in one platform. Instead of presenting environmental data as complicated numbers, it aims to translate that information into understandable agricultural guidance.

Our team considered global accessibility, bilingual support (Arabic and English), ease of use, water conservation, data reliability, and the different environmental conditions farmers face around the world. During development, we also distinguished demonstration readings from verified external data to maintain transparency.

FieldShift AI represents our vision of turning environmental intelligence into practical tools for a smarter, more sustainable agricultural future.
